name: oort-dev
description: Build with Oort: the oort-sdk skill teaches Codex to add Oort memory to your own apps and agents with the oortmem TypeScript SDK and the oort CLI. No hooks and no MCP server; install the oort plugin for memory in your own sessions.

interface.shortDescription: Add Oort memory to your apps
interface.longDescription: A skill for building with Oort, open-source long-term memory for AI agents. It teaches Codex to integrate the oortmem TypeScript SDK (createOort, recall, observe, formatForPrompt, scoped users, judgments, typed errors) and the oort CLI's JSON output into your own apps, services and agent frameworks, with tested examples for the Vercel AI SDK, LangGraph.js and OpenAI Agents JS. It adds no hooks and no MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Add Oort memory to this agent with the oortmem SDK.
Give each user of this app their own Oort memory.
Use Oort from this Python script through the oort CLI.
